top_choice_rationale: Buchwald and Hartwig developed general Pd-catalysed C-N cross-coupling by designing ligands that lowered the hard C-N reductive elimination from Pd-amido complexes. This is a different mechanistic problem from the C-N-free C-C couplings honoured in 2010. The mechanism, the two-name credit and the maturity (over 25 years of independent confirmation) can all be stated and checked, and a citation naming carbon-nitrogen and ligand design keeps it apart from 2010. Among the PROTAC proposals I prefer the Crews/Deshaies/Ciulli configuration because it is a single coherent principle (heterobifunctional recruitment of the ubiquitin-proteasome system), whereas adding Handa joins the cereblon-glue strand as a separate discovery. Phase separation ranks below because it has a single supporter, unsettled physiological scope and credit that cannot be cut cleanly at three; no award stays last because a mature, well-attributed discovery exists.
